notes:
Background: Arcstone runs telemetry and NOC operations for multiple regional power utilities. Evaluating a private/on-prem LLM to accelerate incident triage, SOP retrieval, and runbook summarization.

Key constraints: air-gapped data center footprint in two regions, no persistent outbound connectivity from inference nodes, must present KMS/HSM flow for key material locally, strict retention controls and audit trails for all prompts and responses. Customer repeatedly: "no model weights leaving our network; must be verifiable".

POC ask: ship a self-hosted bundle for an isolated rack (4x A100 equiv), validate model variants (fp16, int8), demonstrate prefix caching and deterministic audit logs for 30-day window. They want a small canary first (30 concurrent chat sessions, 50 req/s embedding backfill), then scale to 500 concurrent sessions.

Commercial: procurement expects a 3-year reserved commit for Dedicated/Private; initial ARR target $500k-$1.5M. Legal/security want SAML SSO, SOC2 evidence and an on-site penetration report before signature.

Quote from CISO (2026-02-08 call): "We will not accept any outbound telemetry that includes user queries or weights — metadata-only health pings only, and we must be able to flip off telemetry at boot."

Stubs and next artifacts: POC plan uploaded to Drive; requested demo logs and sample audit-export format. SE to produce KMS/HSM integration diagram and HSM test harness.
